title: Isandro and the Will
author: Gideon Oyelaran
blurb: Odile Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
